I found no marine heatwave events in the region for 1 June–31 August 2017. Both output files are written to `/work/output/`.

- **Region:** 60×60 grid cells, lat 58.70–59.88 °N, lon 18.70–19.88 °E. Of these, 3,293 are sea cells with finite SST on every target day.
- **Hot days:** 477 cell-days met or exceeded the threshold, but the longest run of consecutive hot days in any sea cell was 4. Since a per-cell MHW needs at least 5, none formed, so the regional event list is empty and the mask is all zeros.
